decision: D-EV-6 (owner, 2026-11-11): the Inspect nightly is capped at USD 10 per night for BOTH engines together, non-blocking at first. Inspect runs each engine's own model, because a record about a different model evidences a different system.
perEngineBasis: The night's cap split evenly; the measured spend is read before each engine starts, and an engine does not start when what is left cannot hold one planned engine pass.

plannedEnginePass.basis: Task 7 alone drives one engine TOKENS cap (200000) per epoch, and the other nine tasks are short runs of a few model calls each. An ESTIMATE until the first keyed nights measure it from the decision log.
